name: Multi-turn refinement and video continuation
prompt: Follow-up: Take the 6s standalone cyberpunk chase prompt we just made, extend it to 8s, remove the spoken dialogue, switch the music to driving industrial drums, and then write a second 5s clip prompt that continues directly from that Video 1 ending while matching its audio energy without copying the raw audio track.

judge.check: Updated first prompt cleanly spans 00.00s-08.00s, omits all [SPEECH] lines without placeholders, updates [MUSIC] + non_diegetic_music to industrial drums, and passes validate_h3_prompt.py.
Continuation prompt uses [video continuation + audio reference], tracks <Video 1> and <Audio 1>: reference cleanly, continues from ending momentum, and passes validate_h3_prompt.py.
